rubrics.justification: Accurately describes an expanded Day-5 blastocyst with thinned zona, adequate/cohesive TE, and less compact ICM consistent with 3BA; appropriately notes limits of judging from a single still image.
Thoroughly integrates age, low AMH/low oocyte yield, prior miscarriages, male factor context, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, linking morphology and clinical history to prognosis; only minor overinterpretation around paternal DNA contribution and exact implantation estimate.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading and standard IVF practice, including transfer of a usable 3BA and preference for single embryo transfer; some suggested workup elements are more discretionary than guideline-mandated.

Provides clear next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support review, cavity reassessment, endocrine evaluation, sperm DNA testing consideration, and nuanced discussion of PGT-A and protocol adjustment.
